text: The homotopy category Ho(C) of an ∞-category C is obtained by:
choices: taking objects and homotopy classes of 1-morphisms
truncating all higher path data above dimension 1
explanation: Ho(C) has the same objects as C, but morphisms are π₀(Map_C(x,y)) — homotopy classes of morphisms. This is the '1-categorical shadow' of C.
